z|medida_sesion_subida: Requests with data to other companies: {salieron} left ({tam}) and {cortados} were blocked
z|medida_sesion_nota: In memory only: erased when ZERO closes. Isolated tabs and AI task tabs are not included.
z|medida_nota_huella: A fingerprint is a set of reads that can recognize your computer without cookies: how it draws text, which graphics card it has, how it renders a sound, which fonts it has. Some websites make them for other reasons, such as drawing or games. ZERO does not change what they read: it only counts it. It looks at the main page, not the frames inside it, and the origin comes from the call stack, which the page itself can alter.
z|medida_nota_grabacion: A session recording service can keep what you do on the page (clicks, movements, what you type) to watch it later. ZERO sees where requests go, not what they carry: “after you typed” does not mean it took what you typed.
z|medida_nota_cifrado: ZERO recognizes the parameter’s name and the value’s shape (a SHA-256 or MD5 hash); it does not keep the value or know whose it is. Hashed does not mean anonymous: the same email always gives the same hash, and it can be used to recognize you.
z|medida_nota_subida: Counts the body of requests (what is sent besides the address). When the browser cannot read it, the request counts without a size. What travels in the address itself is not added.
z|motivo_peligro: danger: malware, scam or phishing (URLhaus and uBlock Origin)

z|medida_nota_ruido: With maximum protection, ZERO gives scripts of other companies a different fingerprint: the canvas and the audio with a tiny change, always the same on this website while ZERO stays open, and a generic graphics card. The website itself and its same owner are never touched, nor a small canvas or one without text. “We gave it a different one” is only said when something really changed.

z|cortes_dice_hash_explica: GUARDIANA did not make this code: it is an email (or phone number) as the website sends it to {empresa}, turned into a code (SHA-256). That way {empresa} matches it with your account without it being readable at a glance. The code cannot be undone, but it can be checked: type your email or phone number and ZERO tells you right here whether it is yours. What you type does not leave this screen.
